headline: AP Housing Scheme: 3D-Printed Houses for the First Time in the Country
summary: The Andhra Pradesh government is building 3D-printed houses for the first time in India under its housing scheme for the poor. The project is in Tenali constituency, Guntur district.
why: Housing schemes drive construction demand and public spending, and 3D printing is an emerging low-cost building method. Investors in construction and building materials follow such programmes.
